Positioning field

Where token projects sit by options activity and valuation.

Read the circles, scope & source inputs

Both axes use logarithmic USD scales. OI covers BTC + ETH; 24h options volume can include additional underlyings, so diagonal turnover guides are indicative. Outer circle area represents reported 30d options fees; filled area represents reported options revenue when available and no greater than fees. A dashed marker means fees are missing; no filled center means revenue is unavailable. The small center dot only marks the coordinate. Financial snapshots more than 48h from token data are excluded from encodings. A high turnover is not automatically better.

OI: direct venue API fallback where the shared feed is missing, otherwise Derivatives Monkey ↗ · options volume: DefiLlama ↗ · fees / revenue: explicitly named options adapters from the DefiLlama fees API ↗. Empty or nonpositive coordinates cannot be drawn on log axes and remain in this table.

What a buyer pays per dollar returned

30d token-holder return versus circulating market cap · protocol-wide.

All token projects · reported values, zeros & missing data

Source: DefiLlama dailyHoldersRevenue ↗. Provider-reported 30d sums may include buybacks, distributions or accounting adjustments. Zero is reported as zero; a missing series is N/A. Negative values need reconciliation and are not treated as a negative cash dividend. The annualized ratio is not an expected investor return. Other products can contribute: do not read this as an options-only yield.
